## What this pull request adds

- [ ] A showcase entry: one folder under `showcase/entries/`
- [ ] A concept or a specification change: one `.md` file under `concepts/`

<!-- One or two sentences on what it is. -->

## Rules checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds one entry or one concept, and nothing else.
- [ ] It contains no code.

### For a showcase entry

- [ ] Every screenshot and clip comes from the Demo instance or a scratch fixture, with fake names that cannot match a real record.
- [ ] No frame shows a key value, a token, a URL with credentials, or an internal hostname.
- [ ] `entry.md` has a caption and names the DataCrafter version the media shows.
- [ ] Every file is PNG, JPG or MP4, at most 10 MB, and images are at least 1200 px wide.
- [ ] The entry has at most eight media files.
- [ ] Every media file has alt text in the `media` list of `entry.md`.

### For a concept

- [ ] The concept is one Markdown file under `concepts/`.
- [ ] It states the problem before the proposal.
- [ ] I understand that a merge means "accepted into the backlog", a promise to consider, not to build.
